'''Feethan Ottraw Scalable Assemblies''' was an [[Utapaun]] company in operation during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==History==
It specialized in [[Self-Constructing Armament Factory|self-constructing armament factories]]<ref name="TCWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> and produced a number of vehicles and vessels for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] after the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] conquered [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]]. Based out of the [[Grand Hall of the Traders' Guild/Legends|Grand Hall of the Traders' Guild]] in [[Pau City/Legends|Pau City]], they churned out hastily-built interceptors to battle [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and native forces during the [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|Battle of Utapau]].<ref name="ROTS:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> The company was part of the Techno Union, which used its self-replicating technology to build factories that could grow throughout the Utapaun landscape.<ref name="ROTS:ICS" />
